policy.new_capability_rule: Every new capability must map to an existing claim or introduce a new falsifiable claim before it is treated as research-relevant.
policy.review_policy: Reviewers must check that every claim remains falsifiable, evidence status is bounded by observed evidence, proof references resolve, and schema compatibility is preserved.

claim:paphos-firmware-cycle.falsifier: After deploy, a staged kernel or pending capsule is not booted within a day, or the journal shows 'Outside of configured reboot window, skipping.' at a 05:00 run.
claim:paphos-firmware-cycle.statement: paphos applies LVFS firmware at 04:30 and reboots for a pending capsule at 06:00 inside its window, and its upgrade reboots land inside 05:00-06:30.

claim:paphos-unattended-unlock.falsifier: After enrollment and an upgrade reboot, paphos waits for the passphrase on initrd SSH port 2222.
claim:paphos-unattended-unlock.statement: After Tang enrollment, paphos reboots in its 05:00-06:30 window and unlocks its LUKS root without a passphrase.

plan.intent: Record narHash and lastModified next to the flake revision, so the deploy report can name the den commit of paphos and oracle, whose upgrade drops self.rev. Make the loving-kypris liveness alert retry failed Telegram deliveries, fail its unit, and offer a test unit.
plan.title: Resolve the den commit under --override-input, and check Telegram delivery

active_boundaries: Current claimed task and isolated work branch

observations: A local temporary flake showed that `nix eval --override-input` drops self.rev and keeps narHash and lastModified. With the override, paphos /etc/den-revision now evaluates to the three lines. On paphos, the deployed 8febc46 had shown `unknown`.
resolve_revision found 8febc46 live from narHash and lastModified, through the GitHub commits API (since=until=lastModified) and nix flake metadata. 10 unit tests and ty pass.

The stubbed liveness simulation showed: the --test mode exits 0 when Telegram answers ok:true and 1 otherwise; a failed DOWN alert is resent at the next sample; a failed RECOVERED message is kept and resent; the unit exits 2 on a delivery failure.
The lease was free after the ironunion-aec-m leases expired at 08:07 UTC. Publication follows the user decision of 2026-11-02, with the known receipt blocker DecapodLabs/decapod#1474.
